record.original_question: For H_n = {(x,y) in Z x Z : xy congruent to 1 mod n and 1 <= x,y <= n-1}, let v(n) be the number of vertices of the convex hull of H_n. Is v(n) forced to tend to infinity with n, and can one sharpen the lower-density estimate for the error term D(n) = v(n) - 2(tau(n-1)-1) on the set where D(n)=0?

evidence.quote: It is easy to see that lim sup v(n) = ∞. Can we show that limn→∞ v(n) = ∞? Also, consider D(n) = v(n) − 2(τ (n − 1) − 1). We know that D(n) > 0 for a set of density 1 in the naturals and furthermore D(n) = 0 on a set which is ≫ x/log x. Can we improve the second estimate?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For an integer $n \geq 2$, define the modular hyperbola
$$H_n = \{(x,y) \in \mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z} : xy \equiv 1 \pmod{n},\ 1 \leq x, y \leq n-1\},$$
and let $v(n)$ denote the number of vertices of the convex hull of $H_n$ in $\mathbb{R}^2$. Let $\tau(\cdot)$ denote the number-of-divisors function, and define
$$D(n) = v(n) - 2(\tau(n-1) - 1).$$
It is known that $\limsup_{n \to \infty} v(n) = \infty$, that $D(n) > 0$ on a set of natural density $1$, and that the set $\{n \leq x : D(n) = 0\}$ has cardinality $\gg x/\log x$.

(a) Prove or disprove that $\lim_{n \to \infty} v(n) = \infty$.

(b) Improve the lower bound $\gg x/\log x$ for the cardinality of $\{n \leq x : D(n) = 0\}$, i.e., establish a stronger lower-density estimate for the set on which $D(n) = 0$.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches reveal active work by Konyagin, Shparlinski and others on upper bounds for the number of vertices of convex hulls of modular hyperbolas (e.g. v_a(m) ≤ m^{1/2+o(1)} and m^{5/12+o(1)} for almost squarefree m), and a survey by Shparlinski on modular hyperbolas, but no source establishes that v(n) → ∞ as n → ∞ or improves the x/log x lower-density estimate for {n : D(n)=0}. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On the Convex Hull of the Points on Modular Hyperbolas
status_evidence.snippet: Konyagin–Shparlinski improve upper bounds for the number of vertices of the convex closure of points on modular hyperbolas.
status_evidence.claim: Active research bounds v(n) from above but does not resolve v(n) → ∞ or improve density bounds for D(n)=0.

status_evidence.title: Modular hyperbolas (survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Shparlinski's survey of distribution and geometric properties of points on xy ≡ a (mod m).
status_evidence.claim: Survey lists open problems about the convex hull but does not record a resolution of the questions on v(n) and D(n).
